name: magicinterview
description: Know what to say next in interviews, client calls, and meetings with live, context-grounded suggestions.

interface.longDescription: MagicInterview helps you know what to say next in job interviews, client calls, sales conversations, and other meetings. Add your CV and the job description, or a client brief and notes. As the conversation unfolds, MagicInterview suggests clear, context-grounded responses you can use or adapt. Open it on your computer or phone; Android also has a native app. Keep each meeting’s context organized, then open the exact MagicInterview conversation when it is time to speak.
defaultPrompt: I have a job interview. Use my CV and the job description to set up live help, then open that MagicInterview conversation.
I finally have a meeting with a potential client. Use our brief and past notes to set up live suggestions for the call.
Prepare today's meetings from my available calendar context and give me MagicInterview links I can open on my phone.
